notice: For education only, not for clinical use.
labels_note: NLP-mined from radiology reports, not radiologist-verified

best_f1.rule: highest F1 per label; predict positive when score >= threshold

sensitivity_80.rule: highest threshold with val sensitivity >= 0.80; labels with fewer than 30 val positives get no threshold (score only)

bootstrap.unit: patient (all images of a drawn patient are kept together)
